title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Body of every non-2xx response of the LSP/1 REST API. `code` equals LsErrorCode.wire in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/ls_exception.dart; the HTTP status for each code is fixed (see LSP-1 section 4.3). A server MUST emit all three members; clients MUST tolerate a missing `message` or `retryable` and MUST map an unknown `code` to INTERNAL. The 426 response adds a top-level `supported` array. AUTH_INVALID (401) and KEY_CHANGED (403) belong to the LSP/1.1 secure profile (Increment 3). A Contacts-only receiver answers a stranger with the plain NOT_FOUND envelope of an unknown route (no new code, LSP-1 section 5.4). Unknown members MUST be ignored.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic. MUST NOT contain file contents, keys, PINs or tunnel URL fragments.

retryable.description: True if the same request may succeed when retried unchanged (after back-off).

supported.description: Only with UPGRADE_REQUIRED (HTTP 426): the protocol majors this server supports, e.g. ["1"]. Top-level sibling of `error`.

error.message: certificate differs from the pinned one for this device
